derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5315 (φάγω);
def: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (ὀψάριον))

occurrences.text: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
